top_signals.title: U.S. Pushes to Restore Russian Gas Flows to Europe
top_signals.summary: The United States has discussed with Russia the possibility of restoring natural gas flows to Europe via pipelines running through Ukraine, the Wall Street Journal has reported, citing unnamed sources involved in the talks. The idea came from President Trump’s envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff and was floated during trips to Moscow and Kyiv in September, the report said. The proposal would involve selling Russian gas through a U.S. intermediary, although such an arrangement would still face significant legal obstacles under the EU's…
